# Deadeye Saloon (Beta)

Welcome to **Deadeye Saloon**, a simple and playful VR showdown you can enjoy **with no controllers, no movement, and no hassle.** Just sit back, raise your hands, and let your gestures decide the duel.
In this saloon, victory comes from **recognizing matching card pairs.** See a pair? **Quickly form the right hand gesture** to strike first and outplay your opponent. Fast reads and fast hands win the round.
